items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: one of the fellows who I believe got on to Art first and started catching on to the key of those harmonic before any of us records of Art was Lannie Scott.

ctx.x: Because Val's was the place. Val's had that big old upright piano in there, and Art loved it. Every time he was in Cleveland, and all the piano players from miles around would come when they heard Art come to town, and one of the fellows who I believe got on to Art first and started catching on to the key of those harmonic before any of us records of Art was Lannie Scott.
